scenes.vo: Last night I found Walt's old badge. The face in the photo was the man who warned me.
So tonight, I rewound the footage from camera three. Every night, the tall thing stood in the same aisle.
But not in the same spot. Every night at three A.M., it took ONE step closer to the counter.
It started the night I looked. The night I glanced at the monitor.
At three A.M., the lights buzzed. I watched the live feed. It lifted one long arm, slowly, toward the back of my head.
I didn't turn around. I didn't breathe. Last night, it was an arm's length away. Tonight it was close enough to touch me.
